principle: The sealed Phase 1 baseline is immutable. This map records how post-seal board-challenge findings are represented in the unsealed candidate; it does not retrospectively edit Phase 1.

integrations.treatment: YED meaning, formula/sign, normal/inferior-product interpretation, assumptions, limitations and decision use strengthened within the existing pricing/elasticity node.

New reusable Network analysis / Critical Path Analysis node covering dependencies, critical path, float, delay, resource/time/quality trade-offs and limitations. Independent APM evidence used for subject truth; board sources remain alignment evidence.
Forecasting now covers historical/trend evidence, time series, moving averages, seasonality, extrapolation, scenarios, sensitivity, structural change and forecast error at bounded Level 3 depth.
Customer journey, CRM/feedback, retention/loyalty, experience and marketing-operations interdependence are explicit facets of the strengthened marketing corpus.
Labour turnover/retention, absence and productivity measures are explicit, with formula-convention cautions, contextual interpretation and links to job design, wellbeing, culture and recruitment.
Investment appraisal includes NPV/time value/discounting at suitable Level 3 depth alongside payback and ARR, with sensitivity and non-financial limitations.
Cost-benefit analysis is represented as structured option appraisal with opportunity cost, non-financial/distributional effects, uncertainty, sensitivity and monetisation limits.

Protectionism/trade-policy mechanics are treated as a genuine reusable gap; FDI/licensing/franchising/joint ventures/direct investment are strengthened subject depth; named international strategy frameworks remain course-specific rather than new factual truth.
Bounded fiscal/monetary transmission to business is explicit without turning the Business foundation into an Economics course.
EPS and ROE are available as optional reusable shareholder-ratio facets with calculation/interpretation limitations rather than universal mandatory depth.
Confidence intervals are included conceptually as sampling-uncertainty/precision evidence; advanced inferential mathematics remains course-selectable.

Flexible/hybrid work, talent development, wellbeing and EDIB are explicit in People; supply-chain transparency/traceability/responsible sourcing are explicit in Operations; ESG/environmental-claim performance boundaries are explicit in External/Global.
AI/disruptive technology remains an application of the existing digital-transformation/capability node; exact current applications belong in course mapping/examples.

Five named-model nodes are serialized as models/qualification conventions with assumptions and criticisms. Individual board-required model sets remain separate course mapping, not proof of new subject fact.
